body: SKETCH v1 (STORY-1889) is posted on the spec: aida show STORY-1889 --comments. It burns KNOWN_UNPROTECTED to zero in 7 PRs: a protected aida-cli-lib/src/gate/ prefix, verbatim moves with re-exports, and a refusal-string inventory diff per PR. Every PR is a human merge. Four questions need a ruling: Q1 scope (also do spec acceptance 1-3 as Phase B, my recommendation, or descope it to a child TASK); Q2 false positives (a floor-resident per-fn exemption list, recommended, or renames); Q3 human-merge count (7 small PRs, or batch them); Q4 re-exports now vs updating callers. No code until signoff; PR 1 also waits for #2832 to merge.
subject: STORY-1889 SKETCH v1 ready for signoff
